Audio Analysis Sub-Modules

Modules within the audio_analysis_modules package.

audio_analysis_modules.chroma_analysis

Functions for chroma analysis, clustering, and section labeling.

audio_analysis_modules.constants

Constants used throughout the audio analysis modules.

audio_analysis_modules.feature_extraction

Functions for feature extraction from audio sections.

audio_analysis_modules.loading

Audio loading and preprocessing functions.

audio_analysis_modules.section_detection

Functions for detecting section boundaries in audio tracks.

audio_analysis_modules.spectral_analysis

Functions for spectral analysis, including stereo width and HPSS decomposition.
